div.p: Only contribute material you are authorised to share. Include author, original URL, licence and attribution details where applicable. Do not reproduce paid or copyright-restricted resources without permission. Contributors remain responsible for having the necessary rights.

div.p: Report suspected infringement, inaccurate attribution or unlawful contributions via , identifying the URL, rights concerned and supporting information. Requests will be reviewed and appropriate measures considered. The final notice-and-action procedures must be assessed against the EU Digital Services Act according to FACODI's actual intermediary role.
